q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a V-belt?
title: V-belt carbon footprint per piece
short: Multiply the rubber compound, cord and fabric cover per belt by supplier figures, then add mixing, building, curing and grinding energy. Divide the plant's energy by belts passed, and report by section and length.
audience: Transmission belt makers and replacement market suppliers

ul: Curing in moulds or pots, then grinding.

p: Report per belt with its section (A, B, C) and length, since material scales with both.

example.title: Worked example: v-belt unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 38,400 / 200,000 = 0.192 kg CO2 per piece
Add rubber and cord for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
